notes.title: ✅ Milestone 1 - More Stuff and Metaprogression Update
notes.content:
Hello Node Farmers! 
It took me some time but wow, how many new things are there! Check it out!

✅Milestone 1 - More Stuff and Metaprogression Update
This milestone is focusing on adding new content, fixing the game balance, gameplay and adding meta progression - everything to close the core game loop.
✅ Improvement: Change islands generation to be procedurally generated and snapped to grid (like nodes)
✅ Improvement: Make everything snap-to-grid/remove non-snap option
Improvement: Round big values (like 20K, 1M, 1B etc)
✅ Experimental: Remake Multiclickers
✅ Improvement: Make selling dishes on the market possible (without special offer)
✅ Feature: Design and implement new production content
✅ Feature: Add new islands and change available resources on them
✅ Feature: Introduce meta-points
✅ Improvement: Storage rework - 3 different types of storages that in summary can store everything. They send all resources at once now (resource transport is much smarter compared to previous versions).
✅ Feature: Gain meta-points on boss defeat, depending on the meta-value of recipe
✅ Feature: Meta-progression - talent tree
✅ Improvement: Make missing graphics
✅ Improvement: Add on-hover info about ingredients in kitchen and other nodes
✅ Feature: Recipes wiki
✅ Improvement: Unlock all 10 bosses
✅ Improvement: Redesign buffs
✅ Improvement: General improvements - controls, tutorial, hints, QoL features

Additionally, I started some parts of Milestone 2:

⬆️ Milestone 2 - Advanced Things Update - in progress
This milestone is focusing on fixing issues/correcting balance from the previous one, adding more advanced features and new play modes. The scope of this one will grow depending on the Milestone 1 feedback.
✅ Feature: Design and implement new logic (flow control) content
✅ Feature: In-game wiki
✅ Bug: radius is not centered on the node
✅ Improvement: Placing nodes on the connection (+ connect this connection to this node)

All your previous saves will be broken because of the scope.
Have fun playing! I am waiting for you on the Discord server!

notes.title: Update v0.3.0
notes.content:
Changelog: v0.3.0
- Feature: REMOVED - Taxes, special events and day counter. Cats and Money Bags are spawned as before but it is not explicit anymore. (nobody liked taxes) 
- Feature: AoE Buffs instead of connection based + lower buff prices; removed buff hub (doesn't makes sense anymore)
- Feature: One Way Road added - it let's resources pass only in the specified direction
- Feature: Paid island reroll (1/4 of island price)
- Feature: Player can enable/disable info and warning popups in the game settings (like "+10 gold" info or "there is no storage" warning messages)
- Improvement: Auto-connection on node placement is disabled on black connections, logic nodes, road nodes and buffs (it was annoying)
- Improvement: Added hotkeys for all tools in the toolkit 
- Improvement: Added boss eternal hunger progress bar (now player can see when and how fast boss will consume stored dish)
- Improvement: Removal area red rectangle is semitransparent now
- Improvement: Important hints are now spawned on the screen center (not on the last hints position or first island)
- Balancing: Bigger storages - 120 -> 150 (storages are better in this update)
- Balancing: Buffs balance (especially storage throughput - from +0.25 to +1)
- Balancing: Changed pricing - most affected are buffs, islands
- Balancing: Harder bosses
- Balancing: More balanced recipes
- Improvement: Camera dragging is more smooth now
- Bug: misplaced vegetable nodes when harvest by multiple farmers at once
- Bug: sometimes hover hints are glitching (not updating) when moving cursor between nodes 
- Bug: island placement blocked - fixed 
- Bug: node stays red after placement - fixed (I hope at least - couldn't reproduce this one, but added some preventive measures)
- Improvement: worst vege market price won't stay the same for the next round - sometimes it could stay for like 7 minutes on the same vegetable which is annoying on early levels. This improvement is a measure to prevent it before reworking pricing system.
- Improvement: current boss recipe dish cannot be selected for special offer
- Improvement: island price involves finished bosses too (not only available islands on the map)
- Bug: "demo finished screen" don't show up if tutorial is disabled
- Bug: resources transported to the markets disappears after special dish offer change
- Bug: airport veggies disappears in flight after changing port number
- Bug: same recipe for both demo bosses
- Improvement: more 1st level dish recipes added to cover all vegetables
- Improvement: improved resource load balancing for kitchen and crafting nodes - they are less affected by consumer starvation problem now when connected in parallel to the resource source
- Bug: player can click nodes while in the settings (event under buttons)
